[LTIM.10.8] **Only `UTC` needs no row.** The designation that is exactly the
string `"UTC"` is offset 0 at every instant, and the engine must resolve it
without consulting any `TimeZoneOffset` fact. Every other designation, `"UTC+8"`,
`"utc"` and `"PST"` included, is a zone name like any other: it resolves only
through facts the host supplied under that exact string ([LTIM.10.7]). The
engine reads no offset out of a designation.
